subtasks: Insert and tighten each screw into the nut of the same color.
Use the left gripper to pick up the blue nut in the center, place it upright on the blue bolt on the left, and screw it down until securely fastened.
Use the right gripper to pick up the loose red nut, place it upright on the red bolt, and screw it down until securely fastened. Leave the blue pair in place.

Pick up the loose yellow nut near the center, place it upright on the yellow bolt to its right, and screw the nut down until securely fastened. Fully open both grippers and return both arms to their initial poses.

Withdraw the open left gripper from the staged yellow nut. Use the right arm to pick up the yellow nut, align it on the yellow bolt to its right, and screw it down upright. Open both grippers and return both arms to their initial poses.

The yellow nut is already on its matching bolt. Use the right gripper to repeatedly grasp, turn clockwise, release, and reset the wrist until the nut is screwed down securely. Then open both grippers and return both arms to their initial poses.
